springbrand.description: SpringBrand connects AI agents to go-to-market capabilities through one connector: social listening across X, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit and Xiaohongshu; website traffic, traffic-source and SEO research; company, contact and creator discovery; and copy, image, video and voiceover generation. Agents discover the right capability, execute it, and return results - billed per call. Hosted remote server, authenticated with OAuth 2.1 (no API key to paste).
